covers.quote: Respect their time by writing in plain language.
Specialist content is more accessible for technical users when written in plain language.

rules.specification: The page does not define an operational test for plain language. It explicitly includes specialist content for technical users.
rules.violation_condition: Content is written in language that is not plain and readily understandable to its intended users.
when: Applies to specialist content as well as content for general consumption.
rules.why: G-4: the plain-language instruction and its later restatement are one rule.

covers.quote: Level AAA requires a lower secondary education reading level, after removal of proper names and titles (year 7 or between 12 and 14 years old).
Writing to an Australian year 7 level makes content usable for most people.

rules.quote: Check that your content is a reading level 2 (Australian year 7 equivalent).
rules.specification: Australian year 7 is the general target. The page does not specify a readability test or scoring method. The WCAG level AAA statement makes the lower-secondary target a requirement in that context.
rules.violation_condition: Content requires a reading level higher than Australian year 7.
when: For WCAG level AAA, assess the reading level after removing proper names and titles.
rules.why: G-2 and G-4: consolidate the reading-level target and its WCAG condition rather than flagging the same reading difficulty twice.

rules.quote: Avoid (or explain) unusual words, phrases, idioms and so on.
rules.specification: The page does not define which expressions count as unusual or what constitutes an adequate explanation.
rules.violation_condition: An unusual word, phrase or idiom appears without an explanation.
when: An unusual expression is acceptable if it is explained.
rules.why: G-2 and G-3: explaining an unusual expression is an exception to avoiding it, not a separate rule.

rules.quote: Expand all acronyms on their first use.
rules.violation_condition: An acronym's first occurrence in the document lacks its expanded form.
when: Applies at the first use of each acronym.
rules.why: One finding concerns one acronym missing its expansion at first use.

rules.violation_condition: A sentence contains a double negative.
rules.why: This is a distinct sentence-level language check, not another reading-level condition.
